properties.name: camel.lra.allowed-coordinator-urls
properties.description: Comma-separated URLs, including the context path, of further LRA coordinators whose LRAs may be joined, completed or compensated. By default, only an LRA hosted by the configured coordinator is accepted. Use it when participants reach the same coordinator under different URLs, for example with different host names.

properties.name: camel.lra.callback-secret
properties.description: Secret used to sign the participant callback URLs that are enlisted with the LRA coordinator, and to verify them when the coordinator calls back. When set, a compensation or completion callback with a missing or invalid signature is rejected with HTTP 403. All the instances of a participant must use the same secret.

properties.name: camel.lra.coordinator-context-path
properties.description: The context path of the LRA coordinator service

properties.name: camel.lra.coordinator-url
properties.description: The base URL of the LRA coordinator service (e.g. http://lra-host:8080)

properties.name: camel.lra.enabled
properties.description: Global option to enable/disable component auto-configuration, default is true.

properties.name: camel.lra.local-participant-context-path
properties.description: The context path of the local participant callback services

properties.name: camel.lra.local-participant-url
properties.description: The local URL where the coordinator should send callbacks to (e.g. http://my-host-name:8080)
